description: Check-in reminders by push (services/checkinReminders.js): the Settings page (/settings) and its Notifications section, the Settings links in the header, the mobile More sheet and the profile, GET/PUT /api/settings/notifications and its push-device endpoints (404 without the flag), and the daily reminder itself (at "staff" only admins get one). Push also needs the WEB_PUSH_* secrets; without them the section says push isn't available. When a Display section lands, ungate the page and gate only Notifications.
